provenance_note: KI-001..KI-200 are a faithful canonical materialization of the approved File Library authority, not a claim of byte-for-byte recovery. KI-201..KI-266 use D2-approved permanent IDs and their approved subclass source files.

entries.name: Lastlight Momentum
entries.mechanic: When an enemy action removes at least 15% of your Max HP, gain 1 Lastlight for 2 turns, maximum 3. At 1 stack, your next direct damaging ability adds 15% Base Damage as Force. At 2 stacks, it also applies Aftershock for 2 turns (target has -10% Blocked Damage Reduction). At 3 stacks, that ability costs 1 less Energy, adds 30% Base Damage as Force instead, and consumes all Lastlight.

entries.name: First Bell Reflex
entries.mechanic: At combat start, if at least one enemy rolls higher Initiative than you, gain First Bell until the end of your first turn. While First Bell is active, the first direct attack targeting you has -10 percentage points effective Dodge success against you; if you Dodge it, your next damaging ability adds 20% Base Damage as Lightning and you gain +2 Initiative on your next calculation.

entries.name: Recalled Kinship
entries.mechanic: The first time one of your summons acts each round, it leaves a Kin Echo on you until the end of your next turn. Your next direct damage consumes the Echo to add 25% Base Damage as Force; your next direct heal instead consumes it to echo 20% of the actual healing to the summon with the lowest HP. The first time you act each round, active summons gain a matching Echo that adds 20% of their normal action as bonus Force damage or bonus healing, depending on that summon’s action.

entries.name: Woundshare Rite
entries.mechanic: Active ability: 1 Energy, 3-turn cooldown. Lose 10% of current HP, not below 1 HP, and mark another real ally with Woundshare for 2 turns. They gain a Shield equal to 15% Max HP. While Woundshare lasts, 20% of actual HP damage they take is copied to you as Dark damage, and every copied packet grants them +8% Incoming Healing until the end of their next turn, stacking twice.

entries.name: Stoneheld Reserve
entries.mechanic: Gain Stoneheld once per combat when you fall below 50% HP. Stoneheld grants a Shield equal to 10% Max HP. While that Shield remains, the first direct attack you Block causes a 20% Base Damage Force recoil against the attacker and applies Heavyfoot for 1 turn (-2 Initiative on its next applicable calculation).

entries.name: Unstable Ovation
entries.mechanic: Track Energy spent. Each time cumulative spending reaches 3 Energy, trigger one Ovation until the end of your next turn; the same Ovation cannot occur twice consecutively. Ember: next direct damaging ability adds 35% Base Damage as Fire and applies Burn for 1 turn. Rime: gain 12% Max HP Shield and the next attacker that hits you receives Frosted (-2 Initiative next calculation). Storm: immediately gain +1 bonus Energy and your next damaging ability adds 25% Base Damage as Lightning. Chorus: your next direct heal or Shield is 25% stronger and grants the target +15% Energy Gain for 1 turn.

entries.name: Washed Thread
entries.mechanic: The first direct heal you perform each turn on a target with an eligible removable non-control negative effect reduces the oldest effect by 1 turn. If this removes it, the target gains Washed Thread for 2 turns: the next direct damaging hit against them is reduced by 10% and the attacker takes 15% Base Damage as Holy. Hard-control effects are never shortened by this Impression.

entries.name: Claimed Attention
entries.mechanic: When you directly damage an enemy that has not targeted you since the end of your previous turn, apply Claim for 2 turns. Claim increases your Final Aggro weight against that enemy by 30%. If the Claimed enemy attacks you, your next direct damaging ability against it adds 20% Base Damage as Physical or Force, chosen when the Impression is equipped at the Tavern.

entries.name: Quickstep Echo
entries.mechanic: The first time you act before every living enemy in a combat, your damaging ability adds 15% Base Damage as Lightning; if the action is not damaging, gain +1 Initiative on your next calculation instead.

entries.name: Quiet Hands
entries.mechanic: The first turn each combat in which no enemy directly targets you, gain Veiled until your next turn. Veiled reduces Final Aggro weight by 8% and causes your next direct hit to add 10% Base Damage as Psychic.

entries.name: Pocket Reserve
entries.mechanic: The first time each combat you fall below 60% HP, create Reserve equal to 5% Max HP. Reserve is not a Shield: the next direct heal you receive consumes it and adds the Reserve amount to that healing.

entries.name: Split-Second Lean
entries.mechanic: While this Kept Impression is equipped, gain +5 percentage points Dodge Chance at all times during combat. This is a direct permanent Dodge Chance bonus and does not require a trigger.

entries.name: Gripstone Poise
entries.mechanic: The first successful Block each combat grants Gripstone until your next turn. Your next direct damaging ability while Gripstone is active adds 15% Base Damage as Force.

entries.name: Warm Thread
entries.mechanic: The first direct healing packet you receive each combat is 10% stronger and leaves Warm Thread for 1 turn. While active, the next Burn applied to you has its duration reduced by 1 turn, minimum 1.

entries.name: Small Current
entries.mechanic: The first time each combat your Energy Gain roll fails to produce bonus Energy, gain Charged Patience. Your next Energy Gain roll gains +25 percentage points. Charged Patience disappears after that roll.

entries.name: Keen Moment
entries.mechanic: While this Kept Impression is equipped, gain +5 percentage points Damage Crit Chance at all times during combat. This is a direct permanent Damage Crit Chance bonus and does not require a trigger. It does not increase Healing Crit Chance.

entries.name: Heavy Followthrough
entries.mechanic: After you deal a damaging Crit, your next non-Crit direct hit before the end of your next turn adds 15% Base Damage as Physical. Does not trigger from echoed or retaliation damage.

entries.name: Patient Edge
entries.mechanic: If you directly damage the same enemy on consecutive turns, the second hit applies Patient Cut for 1 turn: the target takes 10% more damage from your next elemental rider, then Patient Cut ends.

entries.name: First Stitch
entries.mechanic: Your first direct heal each combat also applies Stitch for 2 turns. The next time that target receives direct damage, Stitch heals them for 3% Max HP after the hit resolves.

entries.name: Breathbank
entries.mechanic: If you dealt no direct damage during your previous turn, your next direct damaging ability adds 15% Base Damage as Cold and applies -1 Initiative to the target's next calculation.

entries.name: Last Inch
entries.mechanic: While at 25% HP or lower, the first direct hit against you each round that you successfully Block deals an additional 10% Base Damage as Force back to the attacker.

entries.name: Single Spark
entries.mechanic: When you begin an action at exactly 1 Energy, the first direct damaging packet from that action adds 10% Base Damage as Lightning; a direct healing action instead grants the target +10% Energy Gain until its next turn.

entries.name: Bracefoot
entries.mechanic: After you Dodge, your next Block before the end of your next turn creates a Bracefoot Shield equal to 4% Max HP.

entries.name: Spare Wrap
entries.mechanic: The first Shield you receive each combat stores 20% of the amount actually absorbed. When that Shield breaks or expires, the stored amount heals you, capped at 4% Max HP.

entries.name: Firstward Clarity
entries.mechanic: The first eligible non-control negative effect applied to you each combat has its duration reduced by 1 turn, minimum 1. When it expires, gain +10% Psychic Resistance for 2 turns.

entries.name: Low Flame
entries.mechanic: While at or below 50% HP, your first direct damaging ability each round adds 10% Base Damage as Fire. This rider cannot apply Burn.

entries.name: Covered Heart
entries.mechanic: While you have a Shield, the first damaging Crit dealt to you each combat has its Critical Damage reduced by 15 percentage points.

entries.name: Sure Return
entries.mechanic: The first direct healing you receive below 35% HP each combat leaves Sure Return for 2 turns. If you would fall below 1 HP while it is active, it is consumed and you remain at 1 HP; this cannot prevent campaign defeat from other real allies already being down.

entries.name: Stepwise Pressure
entries.mechanic: Each consecutive turn you directly damage the same enemy, cycle a Pressure rider: first hit adds 12% Base Damage as Physical, second adds 15% as Force, third adds 18% as Fire. The cycle then restarts. Damaging another enemy resets it.

entries.name: Crosscut Habit
entries.mechanic: When your direct damaging ability targets a different enemy than your previous direct damaging ability, add 18% Base Damage as Force and apply Crosscut for 1 turn (-8% Blocked Damage Reduction).

entries.name: Opening Measure
entries.mechanic: The first direct hit you deal each round to an enemy that has not acted yet adds 20% Base Damage as Lightning. If that enemy survives, it gains +1 Initiative on its next calculation, creating a speed-versus-burst tradeoff.

entries.name: Closing Measure
entries.mechanic: Against enemies below 40% HP, your first direct hit each turn adds 20% Base Damage as Dark. You lose 2% Max HP after the rider resolves; cannot reduce you below 1 HP.

entries.name: Shieldbreaker Thread
entries.mechanic: When your direct damage hits a Shield, add a separate 25% Base Damage Force packet that can damage Shields only. If this packet breaks the Shield, apply Rattled Guard for 2 turns (-10% Block Chance).

entries.name: Bare Target
entries.mechanic: Your first direct hit each turn against an enemy with no Shield applies Bare for 2 turns. The next Shield that enemy receives is 20% weaker, then Bare ends.

entries.name: First Strike Memory
entries.mechanic: Your first direct damaging ability each combat gains a 25% Base Damage rider of a damage type selected at the Tavern from Fire, Cold, Lightning, Poison, Force, Psychic, Holy, or Dark. The rider cannot be Physical.

entries.name: Rebound Force
entries.mechanic: After a successful Block, your next direct damaging ability before the end of your next turn adds 30% Base Damage as Force. If it hits the attacker you Blocked, it also applies -10% Blocked Damage Reduction for 1 turn.

entries.name: Missed Step
entries.mechanic: When an enemy Dodges your direct attack, mark it Misread for 2 turns. Your next direct attack against it ignores 10 percentage points of Dodge Chance and adds 20% Base Damage as Psychic.

entries.name: Iron Timing
entries.mechanic: When an enemy Blocks your direct attack, gain Timing against that enemy until the end of your next turn. Your next direct hit against it cannot be Blocked by bonus Block Chance granted after Timing was created, and adds 15% Base Damage as Force.

entries.name: Chosen Resonance
entries.mechanic: At the Tavern choose Fire, Cold, Lightning, Poison, Force, Psychic, Holy, or Dark. Once per turn, the first direct hit you deal of that type creates a Resonance Orb. Your next direct hit of a different type consumes the Orb to add 20% Base Damage of the chosen type.

entries.name: Countercolor
entries.mechanic: After taking direct non-Physical damage, gain Countercolor matching that damage type for 2 turns. Your next direct damaging ability using a different type adds 25% Base Damage of the triggering type, then consumes Countercolor.

entries.name: Unfinished Critical
entries.mechanic: Each damaging ability that fails to Crit adds 1 Unfinished stack, maximum 3. Your next damaging Crit consumes them; per stack, add a separate 10% Base Damage Psychic packet that cannot Crit.

entries.name: Low Guard
entries.mechanic: Below 50% HP, successful Blocks store 20% of the final damage prevented, maximum 10% of your Max HP stored. Your next direct attack releases the stored amount as bonus Force damage, then clears it.

entries.name: Raised Bastion
entries.mechanic: While above 75% HP, the first direct attack you Block each round grants a 5% Max HP Shield. If you are still above 75% HP when that Shield expires, it bursts for 15% Base Damage as Holy against the attacker that created it.

entries.name: Thin Bastion
entries.mechanic: Whenever you receive a Shield smaller than 10% Max HP, it becomes Thin Bastion. The first hit absorbed by it deals 15% Base Damage as Force back to the attacker.

entries.name: Cushion Break
entries.mechanic: When enemy damage completely removes your Shield, gain Cushion Break for 1 turn: the next direct HP damage you take is reduced by 12%, and the source receives 10% Base Damage as Force.

entries.name: First Impact Padding
entries.mechanic: The first direct damaging hit that lands on you each combat deals 10% less final damage and creates an Impact Memory. Your first direct hit against that attacker adds 20% Base Damage of the same damage type it used, if eligible; otherwise Force.

entries.name: Light-Touch Armor
entries.mechanic: Direct hits removing less than 10% Max HP apply Soft Impact to the attacker for 1 turn. Its next direct hit against you deals 8% less damage; repeated Soft Impacts refresh but do not stack.

entries.name: Catch After Dodge
entries.mechanic: After a successful Dodge, gain Catch. If you successfully Block before the end of your next turn, consume Catch to gain +1 bonus Energy and deal 15% Base Damage as Lightning to the attacker.

entries.name: Slip After Block
entries.mechanic: After a successful Block, gain Slip. If you Dodge before the end of your next turn, consume Slip to gain a Shield equal to 6% Max HP and apply -2 Initiative to the attacker’s next calculation.

entries.name: Early Hand
entries.mechanic: During round 1, your first direct damaging ability adds 15% Base Damage as Lightning and your first direct heal adds a 4% Max HP Shield to its target. Only one of each rider can trigger.

entries.name: Late Hand
entries.mechanic: If every living enemy has already acted before you this round, your next direct damaging ability adds 20% Base Damage as Cold; a heal/Shield action instead removes 1 turn from the oldest eligible non-control debuff on its target.

entries.name: Tempo Memory
entries.mechanic: After a damaging Crit, store Tempo until your next turn. If your next action is not the same action category, gain +2 Initiative on your next calculation and add 15% Base Damage as Lightning or +10% healing, matching the new action.

entries.name: Three Misses Make a Mark
entries.mechanic: Three consecutive damaging abilities that fail to Crit mark the target with Certain Wound for 2 turns. Your next direct hit against it gains +15 percentage points Crit Chance and, if it Crits, adds 20% Base Damage as Psychic.

entries.name: Untouched Aim
entries.mechanic: While at full HP, your first direct damaging ability each round gains Aim. If it Crits, add 20% Base Damage as Force; if it does not, gain a 4% Max HP Shield instead.

entries.name: Deep Edge
entries.mechanic: Against enemies above 75% HP, damaging Crits apply Deep Edge for 2 turns. Deep Edge causes the next direct hit against that enemy from you to add 20% Base Damage as Dark, then expires.

entries.name: Return to Zero
entries.mechanic: After an ability leaves you at exactly 0 Energy, gain Empty Circuit until your next turn. Your next natural +1 Energy also creates a 15% chance to gain an additional +1 bonus Energy; whether it succeeds or fails, your next direct hit adds 15% Base Damage as Lightning.

entries.name: Purgewoven Hands
entries.mechanic: All direct healing you perform is 15% weaker. In exchange, every direct heal removes 1 eligible removable debuff of any type from the healed target. Hard-control, boss-protected, encounter-protected, and explicitly uncleansable effects remain ineligible. If at least one debuff is removed, the target gains Purgewoven for 1 turn: +15% Status Resistance. Healing-over-time effects cannot trigger Purgewoven Hands.

entries.name: Current Edge
entries.mechanic: The first time each turn you gain bonus Energy, charge your next direct damaging ability with 20% Base Damage as Lightning. If unused by the end of your next turn, the charge becomes a 5% Max HP Shield instead.

entries.name: Spent Clean
entries.mechanic: After spending 3+ Energy on one ability, gain Clean Spend for 2 turns. The next 0-Energy ability you use adds 20% Base Damage as Force or gains +20% healing/Shield strength, then consumes Clean Spend.

entries.name: Banked Spark
entries.mechanic: If you end your turn with 3+ Energy, store 1 Spark, maximum 1. At the start of a later turn you may automatically consume the Spark to gain +1 bonus Energy; when consumed, your first direct hit that turn adds 15% Base Damage as Lightning. 3-turn internal cooldown.

entries.name: Current Shelter
entries.mechanic: The first time each round you gain bonus Energy, create a Current Shield equal to 4% Max HP. If the Shield survives until your next turn, it discharges 15% Base Damage as Lightning into the last enemy that directly targeted you.

entries.name: Restorative Spend
entries.mechanic: After spending 2+ Energy on one ability, heal 3% Max HP. If already at full HP, instead store a Restoration Charge that makes your next direct heal on another real ally 15% stronger. 2-turn cooldown.

entries.name: Firstcut Zenith
entries.mechanic: While equipped, all direct damage you deal is 10% lower. During your first turn of each combat, gain +35 percentage points Damage Crit Chance and +30 percentage points Critical Damage. If your first damaging ability Crits, it applies Zenith Scar for 2 turns: your next non-Critical direct hit against that enemy deals an additional 25% Base Damage as Force and removes the Scar. If your first damaging ability does NOT Crit, you gain Faltered Aim: your next direct attack has 10% less effective accuracy/hit chance, then Faltered Aim ends.

entries.name: Critical Spark
entries.mechanic: The first damaging Crit each combat grants +1 bonus Energy and Static Memory. Your next direct attack adds 20% Base Damage as Lightning, then Static Memory ends.

entries.name: Mending Focus
entries.mechanic: Directly healing a target below 50% HP applies Focused Mending for 2 turns. The next direct heal you give that same target gains +15% healing and removes Focused Mending.

entries.name: Reciprocal Care
entries.mechanic: After directly healing another real ally, gain Reciprocal Care until your next turn. The next direct heal you receive while active is 15% stronger and grants the original ally a 3% Max HP heal.

entries.name: Overflow Bandage
entries.mechanic: 30% of direct overhealing you produce becomes a Shield, capped at 6% of the target's Max HP per heal. If that Shield breaks before your next turn, the target deals 15% Base Damage as Holy to the attacker that broke it.

entries.name: Guarded Medicine
entries.mechanic: After directly healing another real ally, gain Guarded Medicine for 1 turn. Your next successful Block consumes it to heal that ally for 4% Max HP.

entries.name: Late Mend
entries.mechanic: Directly healing a real ally that has already acted this round applies Aftercare for 1 turn. If they are directly damaged before their next turn, Aftercare heals 4% Max HP after the hit.

entries.name: Early Mend
entries.mechanic: Directly healing a real ally that has not yet acted this round grants Premedicated until that turn begins. Premedicated gives +15% Energy Gain and +5% Dodge Chance until the ally acts.

entries.name: Lifeline Stitch
entries.mechanic: Your first direct heal each combat on a real ally below 25% HP also applies Lifeline for 2 turns. The next non-control debuff applied to that ally has 25% reduced numerical strength, then Lifeline ends.

entries.name: Bright Remedy
entries.mechanic: When one of your direct heals Crits, the target gains Bright Remedy for 2 turns. Its next direct damaging ability adds 15% Base Damage as Holy; if the target does not deal damage, the buff instead increases its next Shield received by 15%.

entries.name: Warm Return
entries.mechanic: After receiving direct healing, gain Warm Return for 2 turns. The next Cold or Dark direct hit against you deals 10% less damage and consumes Warm Return.

entries.name: Current Transfer
entries.mechanic: After directly healing another real ally, grant Conductive Care for 2 turns. The first time that ally gains bonus Energy, it deals 15% Base Damage as Lightning to the last enemy it directly damaged.

entries.name: Shielded Care
entries.mechanic: Directly healing a Shielded target stores 20% of actual HP restored inside the Shield. When the Shield breaks or expires, the stored healing is released, capped at 5% of the target’s Max HP.

entries.name: Triage Rhythm
entries.mechanic: When you directly heal a different real ally than your previous direct-heal target, apply Triage Beat for 1 turn. The healed ally gains +8% Incoming Healing and its next direct hit adds 10% Base Damage as Holy.

entries.name: Venom Shedding
entries.mechanic: Poison applied to you has its initial duration reduced by 1 turn, minimum 1. When a Poison effect expires or is removed from you, your next direct hit adds 20% Base Damage as Poison but cannot apply a new Poison.

entries.name: Burn Shedding
entries.mechanic: Burn damage against you is reduced by 12%. When a Burn effect ends on you, gain Cinder Skin for 2 turns; the next direct attacker takes 15% Base Damage as Fire.

entries.name: Weakness Mirror
entries.mechanic: When you apply an eligible non-control debuff to an enemy, create a Mirror tag on it for 2 turns. The first direct hit you deal to a Mirrored target adds 15% Base Damage matching the damage type of the hit and removes the tag.

entries.name: Debuff Reflex
entries.mechanic: The first new eligible non-control negative effect applied to you each round grants Reflex until your next turn. If you Dodge while Reflex is active, transfer a 50%-strength numerical copy of that debuff to the attacker when legal.

entries.name: Marked Resolve
entries.mechanic: While suffering 2+ different negative statuses, gain Resolve. The first ability you use each turn while Resolve is active adds 15% Base Damage as Holy if damaging, or gains +15% healing/Shield strength otherwise.

entries.name: Shedding Closure
entries.mechanic: When an eligible non-control negative effect on you expires naturally, heal 3% Max HP and gain Closure for 1 turn. Closure makes the next direct damaging hit against you deal 5% less final damage. Once per turn.

entries.name: Status Opportunist
entries.mechanic: Against enemies with 2+ different negative statuses, your first direct hit each turn adds 15% Base Damage as Psychic. At 4+ different statuses, the rider becomes 25%.

entries.name: Status Precision
entries.mechanic: Damaging a target with any negative status grants Sightline against it until your next turn. Your next damaging ability against that target gains +6 percentage points Crit Chance; if it Crits, extend one eligible non-control debuff by 1 turn.

entries.name: Fresh Cut
entries.mechanic: The first eligible numerical non-control debuff you apply each combat is 20% stronger and gains Fresh Cut. When that debuff expires, deal 20% Base Damage as Poison to the target.

entries.name: Lingering Note
entries.mechanic: The first eligible non-control debuff you apply each combat lasts +1 turn. On its final turn, the target also suffers Lingering Note: -10% Energy Gain for that turn. Hard-control duration is never extended.

entries.name: Twin Resistance
entries.mechanic: Gain a paired ward against Force and Psychic. The first time each combat you take either type, gain +15% Resistance to the other type for 2 turns and your next direct hit adds 15% Base Damage of the type you resisted.

entries.name: Chosen Ward
entries.mechanic: At the Tavern choose one damage type. The first direct hit of that type you take each combat is reduced by 15%; afterward, gain a Ward Charge that causes your next direct hit to add 20% Base Damage of the chosen type.

entries.name: Summoner's Wake
entries.mechanic: The first time one of your summons deals direct damage each round, it leaves a Wake. Your next direct damaging ability consumes the Wake to add 15% Base Damage matching the summon’s damage type; if it has no damage type, use Force.

entries.name: Sturdier Echo
entries.mechanic: Your summons gain +10% Max HP. The first time each summon falls below 50% HP, it gains Echo Bark for 2 summon turns: +10% resistance to all damage and immunity to forced repositioning.

entries.name: Summoned Precision
entries.mechanic: The first damaging Crit dealt by each summon per combat marks its target for 2 turns. Your next direct hit against that target gains +8 percentage points Crit Chance.

entries.name: Summoned Shelter
entries.mechanic: The first time one of your summons restores HP each round, it gains a Shield equal to 6% Max HP. If that Shield survives until its next action, its next heal gains +15% strength.

entries.name: Companion Current
entries.mechanic: After the first action taken by one of your summons each round, gain +15% Energy Gain until your next turn. If you gain bonus Energy during that window, the acting summon gains +20% numerical strength on its next action.

entries.name: Shared Footing
entries.mechanic: While at least one summon is alive, the first successful Dodge you perform each combat grants all active summons +2 Initiative on their next summon-order calculation and +10% damage/healing for one action.

entries.name: Material Thread
entries.mechanic: After victory, gain 10% additional eligible ordinary regional materials. In addition, the first material gained from this bonus each expedition is marked Threaded; the next recipe that uses that exact material consumes one fewer copy, minimum 1. Excludes Onyx, Unique, boss, quest, and first-clear rewards.

entries.name: Prepared Flask
entries.mechanic: The first equipped combat consumable you use each battle has eligible numerical effects increased by 20% and leaves an Aftertaste based on its primary effect: healing grants +10% Incoming Healing for 2 turns; damage grants +10% damage of that consumable's type for 2 turns; Shield grants +10% Blocked Damage Reduction for 2 turns.

entries.name: Pocket Discipline
entries.mechanic: Increase equipped combat-consumable cap from 5 to 6. The first time each combat you use the sixth slot specifically, gain +1 Initiative on your next calculation and +10% Energy Gain until your next turn.

entries.name: Steady Return
entries.mechanic: After combat, if you are above 50% HP, restore an additional 5% Max HP before the mandatory Campsite. If already at full HP, instead begin the Campsite with Steady Return, causing the first Exhaustion removal or recovery effect there to gain +20% numerical strength.

entries.name: Farside Rhythm
entries.mechanic: Alternating between a damaging action and a healing/Shielding action creates Farside stacks, maximum 3. Damage after support adds 15% Base Damage as Holy; support after damage grants a 5% Max HP Shield. At 3 stacks, the next alternating action gains both riders and clears the stacks.

entries.name: Red Margin
entries.mechanic: Below 40% HP, direct damage builds Red Ink, maximum 3. Each stack makes your next direct heal on yourself or another ally 8% stronger. Direct healing builds White Ink instead; each White Ink makes your next direct hit add 12% Base Damage as Dark. Using the opposite action consumes all stored Ink.

entries.name: Shieldwake Edge
entries.mechanic: While Shielded, your direct hits charge the Shield with 10% of actual HP damage dealt, capped at 10% Max HP. When the Shield breaks or expires, release the charge as Force damage against the last enemy you directly hit. The release cannot Crit or Lifesteal.

entries.name: Precision Debt
entries.mechanic: Damaging Crits build Precision Debt, maximum 3. A damaging ability that fails to Crit consumes all Debt: per stack, add 12% Base Damage as Psychic and gain +3 percentage points Crit Chance on the next damaging ability.

entries.name: Grave Pace
entries.mechanic: Each consecutive turn you deal direct damage without a Crit grants 1 Grave Pace, maximum 3. At 3, your next direct damaging ability adds 35% Base Damage as Dark and marks the target Mourned for 2 turns; healing you receive from Lifesteal against Mourned targets is 25% stronger.

entries.name: Threshold Vigil
entries.mechanic: The first time each round another real ally falls below 30% HP, mark the enemy responsible with Vigil for 2 turns. You gain +50% Final Aggro weight against it. If it attacks you, reduce that hit by 10% and your next direct hit against it adds 25% Base Damage as Holy.

entries.name: Warm Exchange
entries.mechanic: Directly healing another real ally stores 20% of actual HP restored as Heat, capped at 10% of your Max HP. Your next direct damaging ability consumes Heat and adds that amount as Fire damage. Direct damage instead stores 10% of actual HP removed as Mercy, capped at 8% Max HP; your next direct heal consumes Mercy and adds it to the heal.

entries.name: Carried Momentum
entries.mechanic: A successful Dodge grants Windstep; a successful Block grants Stonebeat. Holding both at once upgrades them to Cross-Momentum. Your next damaging ability consumes Cross-Momentum to add 20% Base Damage as Force and 20% as Lightning; your next heal/Shield instead gains +25% strength.

entries.name: Unspent Current
entries.mechanic: If you end your turn with 2+ Energy, store the amount above 1 as Current, maximum 3 Current. Your next ability may consume all Current: damaging abilities add 12% Base Damage as Lightning per Current; healing/Shielding gains +8% strength per Current.

entries.name: Current Dividend
entries.mechanic: Every bonus Energy gained adds 1 Dividend, maximum 3. Your next 3+ Energy ability consumes all Dividend. Per stack: direct damage adds 15% Base Damage as Lightning; direct healing adds 3% target Max HP; Shields gain +5% strength.

entries.name: Recovery Circuit
entries.mechanic: After spending 3+ Energy on one ability, heal 5% Max HP and gain Recovery Circuit for 2 turns. If you gain bonus Energy while it is active, convert the first bonus Energy gained into a 10% Max HP Shield instead. 2-turn cooldown.

entries.name: Quickening Critical
entries.mechanic: After a damaging Crit, gain Quickening for 2 turns. The first time you gain bonus Energy while Quickening is active, immediately add +1 Initiative to your next calculation and charge your next direct hit with 20% Base Damage as Lightning.

entries.name: Shield Feeder
entries.mechanic: The first direct heal you receive each turn grants a Shield equal to 20% of actual HP restored, capped at 8% Max HP. While that Shield remains, your direct damaging Crits restore 10% of the Shield’s original value, once per turn.

entries.name: Overheal Keeper
entries.mechanic: 50% of direct overhealing you receive becomes a Shield, capped at 12% Max HP per heal. When an Overheal Shield breaks, the attacker gains Overfed for 2 turns: -10% Incoming Healing and -10% Shield strength received.

entries.name: Bastion Rhythm
entries.mechanic: A successful Block grants 1 Bastion Beat, maximum 3. Your next direct attack consumes all Beats and adds 15% Base Damage as Force per Beat. At 3 Beats it also applies Crumpled Guard for 2 turns (-15% Blocked Damage Reduction).

entries.name: Evasive Rhythm
entries.mechanic: A successful Dodge grants 1 Evasive Beat, maximum 3. Your next direct damaging ability consumes all Beats and adds 10% Base Damage as Lightning per Beat plus +4 percentage points Crit Chance per Beat.

entries.name: Two-Step Guard
entries.mechanic: After a Dodge, gain Stone Step; after a Block, gain Wind Step. If you trigger the opposite defense while one Step is active, consume both to gain +1 bonus Energy and a 6% Max HP Shield. Only one Step of each type may exist.

entries.name: Debuff Weaver
entries.mechanic: Applying a different eligible non-control debuff to an enemy that already has one creates a Weave Link for 2 turns. While linked, the older debuff is 15% stronger and the newer debuff deals 10% Base Damage as Psychic at the start of the target’s turn. Maximum one Link per enemy.

entries.name: Cleanse Reward
entries.mechanic: When you remove an eligible non-control negative effect from another real ally, both of you gain Clean Current for 2 turns. The first time either character gains bonus Energy, the other gains +1 bonus Energy as well. Once per ally per combat.

entries.name: Exposure Harvest
entries.mechanic: Removing an eligible positive buff from an enemy creates Harvested Light matching that buff's broad role. Offensive buff: next hit adds 25% Base Damage as Holy. Defensive buff: gain 8% Max HP Shield. Healing/resource buff: gain +1 bonus Energy. Once per enemy per 3 turns.

entries.name: Singular Hunt
entries.mechanic: After directly damaging the same enemy on 3 consecutive turns, mark it as Singular Prey. Your attacks against it alternate riders: 20% Base Damage Poison, then 20% Force, then 20% Dark, repeating. Hitting another enemy removes the mark.

entries.name: Reprisal Pivot
entries.mechanic: When an enemy deals a damaging Crit to you, mark it Pivoted for 2 turns. Your next direct hit against it adds 25% Base Damage as Psychic and copies 20% of the Critical Damage bonus that enemy used onto your hit, capped at +30 percentage points.

entries.name: Second Windglass
entries.mechanic: The first time each combat you fall below 25% HP and remain alive, heal 12% Max HP and gain Windglass for 2 turns. The next direct hit against you is converted: 20% of its final HP damage becomes a Shield instead of HP loss.

entries.name: Split Guard
entries.mechanic: The first direct damaging hit that lands on you each round is split into Hit and Echo: reduce the Hit by 8%, then store the prevented amount. Your next successful Block releases the stored amount as Force damage, capped at 8% Max HP.

entries.name: Shared Wall
entries.mechanic: While another real ally is below 50% HP, gain Shared Wall. Your first Dodge or Block each round while active grants that ally a 5% Max HP Shield. If they already have a Shield, heal them for 3% Max HP instead.

entries.name: Summoner's Circuit
entries.mechanic: When a summon deals damage, charge Damage Circuit; when a summon restores HP, charge Mercy Circuit. Holding both causes your next ability to gain both effects: damaging adds 20% Base Damage as Force, healing/Shielding gains +20% strength. Then both charges clear.

entries.name: Borrowed Body
entries.mechanic: The first time one of your summons is defeated each combat, gain Borrowed Body for 2 turns: 15% Max HP Shield, +1 bonus Energy, and your next direct damaging ability gains a 25% Base Damage rider matching that summon’s primary damage type.

entries.name: Hoststep Measure
entries.mechanic: The first time a summon acts after you each round, it copies your last action category. If your last action dealt damage, the summon adds 20% Force damage to its action; if you healed/Shielded, its next healing or defensive effect is 20% stronger.

entries.name: Kinward Canopy
entries.mechanic: When you grant a Shield to one of your summons, gain 30% of that Shield amount on yourself, capped at 8% Max HP per turn. If both Shields survive until the summon’s next action, its action gains +20% numerical strength.

entries.name: Elemental Relay
entries.mechanic: Directly dealing one damage type stores it as Relay A. Dealing a different type stores Relay B. Once both are stored, your next direct damaging ability adds 15% Base Damage of each stored type, then clears both. Physical may be stored, but the bonus riders cannot both be Physical.

entries.name: Twin Affinity
entries.mechanic: At the Tavern choose two non-identical damage types. Direct hits of Type A apply A-Tuned for 2 turns; direct hits of Type B against A-Tuned targets add 25% Base Damage of Type A and flip the mark to B-Tuned. Alternating continues without a flat passive damage bonus.

entries.name: Critical Shelter
entries.mechanic: The first damaging Crit each round grants a 5% Max HP Shield. If that Shield survives until your next turn, your first direct hit that turn adds 15% Base Damage as Holy.

entries.name: Healing Shelter
entries.mechanic: The first healing Crit you perform each turn grants the healed target an 8% Max HP Shield. If that Shield is broken by enemy damage, the target’s next direct heal received gains +20% strength.

entries.name: Roadfeast Memory
entries.mechanic: The first time during a campaign that you consume each distinct eligible food, its healing and all other positive numerical effects are increased by +125% (2.25× normal), and it removes 1 eligible removable Burn, Poison, Bleed, or other damage-over-time effect from you when applicable. After consuming 4 different eligible foods during that campaign, gain 12 unallocated Stat Points for the current campaign. The 12 Stat Points are granted only once per campaign and disappear when that campaign ends.

entries.name: Trailstock Satchel
entries.mechanic: Increase equipped combat-consumable cap by 1. The first consumable used each battle gains a Trailstock Echo: on your next turn, repeat 25% of its eligible healing, damage, Shield, or Energy effect without consuming another item. Echo cannot repeat control.

entries.name: Measured Aggression
entries.mechanic: If Final Aggro weight is at or below 0.50 when you act, your first direct hit each turn applies Hidden Measure for 2 turns. Your next hit against that enemy adds 20% Base Damage as Psychic; taking direct damage clears all Hidden Measures.

entries.name: Measured Presence
entries.mechanic: While Final Aggro weight is at or above 1.50, enemies that directly hit you gain Measured Threat for 1 turn. Your first Block against a Threatened enemy reduces its outgoing damage by 10% for 2 turns and deals 15% Base Damage as Force.

entries.name: Aftercare
entries.mechanic: When combat ends with no real ally defeated, all surviving real allies restore 4% Max HP before Campsite and gain Aftercare for the Campsite: the first eligible negative status removed there also grants a 5% Max HP heal.

entries.name: Vacant Crown Wager
entries.mechanic: Each consecutive damaging ability that fails to Crit adds 1 Vacant Crown, maximum 4. On a damaging Crit, consume all Crowns. Per Crown consumed, add 12% Base Damage as Psychic. At 4 Crowns, also apply Crownshock for 2 turns (-15% Crit Chance and -15% Energy Gain).

entries.name: Fortress Echo
entries.mechanic: The first successful Block each round creates an Echo Wall equal to 8% Max HP. Echo Wall is a separate Shield. If it survives until your next turn, your next direct damaging ability detonates it, consuming the Shield and adding its remaining value as Force damage, capped at 12% of your Max HP.

entries.name: Mirrorstep Current
entries.mechanic: Every second successful Dodge grants +1 bonus Energy and Mirrorstep for 2 turns. Your next direct damaging ability while Mirrorstep is active creates a mirrored 30% Base Damage Psychic hit against a different enemy if one exists; otherwise it repeats on the same target at 20%.

entries.name: Scarred Current
entries.mechanic: When an enemy action removes at least 15% Max HP, gain Scar Current for 2 turns and +1 bonus Energy. While active, the next direct damage you deal adds 30% Base Damage as Lightning and heals you for 20% of that rider's actual HP damage. 2-turn cooldown.

entries.name: Bloodline Margin
entries.mechanic: Below 50% HP, your direct damaging abilities alternate Bloodline riders: Fire, Dark, then Physical, each adding 20% Base Damage. Every rider costs 2% Max HP, not below 1. Direct healing received resets the sequence to Fire.

entries.name: Zero-Loop Return
entries.mechanic: If you end your turn at exactly 0 Energy, create Zero Loop. At the start of your next turn, gain the normal +1 Energy plus +1 bonus Energy. Your first ability that turn leaves a Loop Echo: if damaging, add 20% Base Damage as Force; if healing/Shielding, repeat 15% of the final numerical effect. 2-turn cooldown.

entries.name: Overdraw Rhythm
entries.mechanic: After using a 4+ Energy ability, gain Overdraw for 2 turns. Your next ability costs 1 less Energy, minimum 0. If that discounted ability costs 0 after reduction, it also adds 25% Base Damage as Lightning or gains +25% healing/Shield strength. 3-turn cooldown.

entries.name: Ghostwake Instinct
entries.mechanic: Whenever your current Energy reaches your current maximum/cap from below, gain Ghostwake until the end of your next turn. Ghostwake can trigger again later in the same combat only after your Energy first falls below maximum and then reaches maximum again. While Ghostwake is active, your Final Aggro weight is multiplied by 0.30, you gain +20 percentage points Dodge Chance, and the next direct attack that successfully hits you deals 25% less final damage. Your next direct damaging ability gains +15 percentage points Crit Chance. If you Dodge an attack before using that empowered damaging ability, it also deals an additional 25% Base Damage as Psychic. Ghostwake ends after the empowered damaging ability resolves or at the end of your next turn, whichever happens first.

entries.name: Shared Pulse
entries.mechanic: The first time each turn you directly heal another real ally, heal yourself for 20% of actual HP restored and create a Pulse Link for 1 turn. If either linked character gains bonus Energy while linked, both gain +15% Energy Gain until their next turns.

entries.name: Kindleline Call
entries.mechanic: At combat start, every real party member gains a Shield equal to 6% of their Max HP. The real ally with the lowest current HP percentage gains Kindled for 2 turns. Kindled grants +10% Damage and +10% Incoming Healing. If that ally's starting Shield is completely destroyed by enemy damage while Kindled remains, they immediately heal 4% Max HP and gain +1 Energy.

entries.name: Tempered Recoil
entries.mechanic: Each successful Block grants 1 Recoil, maximum 6. Your next direct damaging ability consumes all Recoil. For each stack consumed, add 10% Base Damage as Force. At 3+ Recoil, the target also receives Bent Guard for 2 turns: -15% Blocked Damage Reduction. At 6 Recoil, the bonus Force damage becomes an explosion and every other enemy takes 40% of that bonus Force damage. Recoil clears after combat.

entries.name: Clean Hand
entries.mechanic: The first time each combat you remove an eligible non-control negative effect from another real ally, gain +1 bonus Energy and grant a 10% Max HP Shield. That ally also gains Clean Hand for 2 turns; its next direct hit adds 25% Base Damage as Holy.

entries.name: Debuff Constellation
entries.mechanic: Each different negative status on an enemy lights one Constellation point, maximum 5. At 3 points, your first direct hit each turn adds 20% Base Damage as Psychic. At 5 points, the rider becomes 35% and one eligible numerical debuff on the target is 15% stronger until the end of its current duration.

entries.name: Condition Engine
entries.mechanic: The first time each enemy reaches 3 simultaneous different negative statuses, gain +1 bonus Energy and create an Engine Token, once per enemy per combat. Spend 2 Engine Tokens automatically on your next direct hit to add 40% Base Damage as Force and extend one eligible non-control debuff by 1 turn.

entries.name: Status Mirror
entries.mechanic: The first eligible numerical non-control debuff applied to you each combat is mirrored to its source at 60% numerical strength for the same remaining duration. While both mirrored copies exist, your direct hits against that source add 15% Base Damage as Psychic. No hard control, boss, or protected effects.

entries.name: Summon Covenant
entries.mechanic: Your summons become Covenantbound. Their first action each round gains +25% numerical strength. Whenever a Covenantbound summon acts, your own next direct damage/heal/Shield is 8% weaker; if you wait until after every active summon has acted, that penalty converts into +20% instead. This creates a summon-first turn-order build rather than a permanent stat boost.

entries.name: Manybody Accord
entries.mechanic: Each active summon grants a different Body note in summon order, maximum 3: First Body adds 15% Base Damage as Force to your next hit; Second Body grants your next heal +20%; Third Body grants a 7% Max HP Shield. Using an effect consumes only its matching Body note; notes refresh when those summons act.

entries.name: Fallen Retinue
entries.mechanic: The first summon defeated each round leaves a Fallen Echo for 2 turns. Your next direct damaging ability consumes it to add 35% Base Damage matching the fallen summon’s primary damage type; your next heal instead consumes it to revive 20% of the summon’s Max HP as a temporary Shield on yourself. It does not revive the summon.

entries.name: Shield Alchemy
entries.mechanic: When enemy damage completely removes a Shield from you, distill 25% of the amount removed by the final hit into an Alchemical Charge, capped at 8% Max HP. Your next direct hit consumes the Charge as Poison damage; your next direct heal consumes it as bonus healing. Once per turn.

entries.name: Healing Alchemy
entries.mechanic: Track direct overhealing you produce. Each cumulative 20% of your Max HP in overheal creates one Distillate, maximum 2. A damaging ability consumes one Distillate to add 30% Base Damage as Holy; a Shielding ability consumes one to increase the Shield by 20% and grant +15% Incoming Healing for 1 turn.

entries.name: Warding Reciprocity
entries.mechanic: When you grant a Shield to another real ally, gain 30% of the amount on yourself, capped at 10% Max HP per turn. If both Shields are damaged by the same enemy before your next turn, that enemy receives 30% Base Damage as Force and is Reciprocity-Broken for 1 turn (-15% Blocked Damage Reduction).

entries.name: Trispectrum Relay
entries.mechanic: At the Tavern choose 3 different damage types. Directly dealing one chosen type records it. After you have recorded all 3 in any order, your next direct damaging ability becomes a Relay Burst: add 20% Base Damage of each recorded type as three separate riders, then clear the record. Repeating a type before completing the set does not reset progress.

entries.name: Surgeback Current
entries.mechanic: Whenever you spend 4 or more Energy on a single ability, prepare Surgeback for your next turn. At the start of that turn, your first ability costs 1 less Energy, minimum 0. If it deals direct damage, it also deals an additional 30% Base Damage as Lightning. If it directly heals or grants a Shield instead, its final numerical effect is 25% stronger. Surgeback cannot stack with itself before being consumed.

entries.name: Vital Tempo
entries.mechanic: For each cumulative 20% Max HP you restore to other real allies during a round, gain 1 Vital Beat, maximum 3. At the start of your next turn, consume all Beats: +1 Initiative per Beat on the next calculation, and your first direct hit adds 10% Base Damage as Holy per Beat.

entries.name: Hard Turn
entries.mechanic: Each different enemy that directly targets you during a round grants one Hard Turn stack, maximum 3. At 3 stacks, your next successful Block releases a Shockring: deal 25% Base Damage as Force to every enemy that targeted you that round and apply -10% outgoing damage for 1 turn.

entries.name: Low-Profile Edge
entries.mechanic: While Final Aggro weight is at or below 0.50, direct hits place Low-Profile Cuts, maximum 2 per enemy. When that enemy targets someone else, consume all Cuts; each Cut deals 15% Base Damage as Psychic. Taking direct damage clears all Cuts.

entries.name: High-Profile Bastion
entries.mechanic: While Final Aggro weight is at or above 1.50, the first direct hit from each enemy marks it with High Profile for the round. A successful Block against a marked enemy deals 20% Base Damage as Holy and grants the lowest-HP other real ally a 4% Max HP Shield.

entries.name: Full-Hand Casting
entries.mechanic: When you begin an action with 3+ Energy, you may invoke Full Hand. After the action resolves, lose 1 additional Energy if available. Damaging actions add 40% Base Damage split evenly between Force and Psychic; healing/Shielding actions gain +25% numerical strength and remove 1 turn from one eligible non-control debuff on the target.

entries.name: Empty-Hand Casting
entries.mechanic: When you begin an action at exactly 1 Energy, invoke Empty Hand once per turn. The action gains one rider based on category: Damage adds 25% Base Damage as Lightning; Heal grants +1 bonus Energy to the target after healing; Shield grants +20% Shield strength and +1 Initiative on the target’s next calculation.

entries.name: Doorstep Gambit
entries.mechanic: On your first turn each combat, choose automatically based on your first action. Attack: add 40% Base Damage as a random non-Physical type, but the first direct hit you take that round deals 15% more damage. Heal/Shield: gain +35% effect strength, but your Final Aggro weight increases by 50% until your next turn.

entries.name: Brightglass Bargain
entries.mechanic: Your Max HP is reduced by 15%. In exchange, every damaging Crit creates one Glass Shard, maximum 3. Your next direct damaging ability may consume all Shards automatically: each adds 20% Base Damage as Holy and 20% as Force, but if the ability fails to Crit you take 3% Max HP damage per Shard consumed, not below 1.

entries.name: Wallbound Refrain
entries.mechanic: Whenever you Block, gain one Wall Note, maximum 3. Each Wall Note reduces your outgoing direct damage by 5% while held. At 3 Notes, your next Block consumes them to create a party-wide Shield equal to 8% of each real ally’s Max HP and deal 40% Base Damage as Force to the attacker.

entries.name: Deep Current Engine
entries.mechanic: At the start of every second turn you take, gain +1 bonus Energy. Every bonus Energy gained also adds 1 Engine Charge, maximum 4. At 4 Charges, your next 3+ Energy ability consumes them: damaging abilities add 60% Base Damage as Lightning; healing/Shielding abilities repeat 30% of their final effect on the lowest-HP other real ally.

entries.name: Red Thread Pact
entries.mechanic: Gain 8% Lifesteal from actual HP removed by direct damage, but Outgoing Healing is reduced by 20%. Every 10% Max HP restored through Lifesteal creates 1 Red Thread, maximum 3. At 3 Threads, your next direct hit adds 50% Base Damage as Dark and consumes them. Incoming Healing still modifies Lifesteal normally.

entries.name: White Thread Pact
entries.mechanic: Your direct heals and Shields are 20% stronger, but direct damage is reduced by 12%. Every time you restore or Shield another real ally for at least 10% of their Max HP in one action, gain 1 White Thread, maximum 3. At 3 Threads, your next direct damaging ability is no longer penalized and adds 50% Base Damage as Holy, then consumes them.

entries.name: Retinue Primacy
entries.mechanic: Your summons become the primary engine. Each active summon gains a Primacy role in summon order: first gains +30% damage, second +30% healing/Shielding, third +20% Max HP and all resistances. Your own direct damage is reduced by 10% while any summon lives. Each time a summon completes its action, your next action gains a role-dependent echo: 20% Force damage, +20% healing, or 8% Max HP Shield.

entries.name: Debuff Architect
entries.mechanic: You may maintain one Architecture on each enemy. Applying three different eligible non-control debuffs to the same enemy completes its Architecture for 2 turns. Completed Architecture causes your first direct hit each turn to add 35% Base Damage as Psychic, and all eligible numerical debuffs you personally applied to that enemy are 20% stronger. Hard-control duration is never changed.

entries.name: Keenstep Spiral
entries.mechanic: Damaging Crits advance a four-step Spiral: Force → Lightning → Psychic → Dark. Your next direct damaging ability adds 25% Base Damage of the current Spiral type. If that ability Crits, advance to the next type and keep the Spiral; if it does not Crit, the Spiral collapses and you gain a 10% Max HP Shield instead.

entries.name: Wardfall Return
entries.mechanic: Every Shield you receive or grant becomes a Wardfall Shield. When a Wardfall Shield breaks from enemy damage, it leaves a Return Seed for 2 turns. On you: next direct hit adds 30% Base Damage as Force. On an ally: their next direct hit adds 20% Holy damage, or their next heal gains +20% strength. Maximum one Seed per character.

entries.name: Wounded Sovereign
entries.mechanic: Below 50% HP, gain Sovereign Wound. Each direct hit you deal while wounded stores 8% of actual HP damage as Authority, capped at 15% Max HP. When you rise above 75% HP, Authority detonates against your most recently damaged enemy as Dark damage and grants every real ally a Shield equal to 25% of the stored amount.

entries.name: Threefold Tempo
entries.mechanic: Track three action categories: Damage, Healing/Shielding, Utility/Defense. Using all three in any order without repeating completes a Threefold Phrase. Your next action gains all three echoes: damaging actions add 30% Base Damage as Lightning; healing/Shielding gains +25% effect strength; utility/defense grants +1 bonus Energy after resolution. Then the Phrase resets.

entries.name: Single-Spectrum Accord
entries.mechanic: At the Tavern choose one damage type. All bonus elemental riders created by your Kept Impressions convert to the chosen type. Each time you deal direct damage of the chosen type on 3 consecutive turns, gain Accord for 2 turns: +20% Resistance to that type and your next direct hit applies Spectrum Scar, causing the target to take +15% damage of that type for 2 turns. Physical may be chosen, but does not convert non-Physical status riders.

entries.name: Crisis Wardline
entries.mechanic: When another real ally falls below 35% HP, draw a Wardline between you for 2 turns. The first direct hit against either linked character each round is reduced by 12%; 20% of the prevented amount becomes a Shield on the other character. Your direct heals on the linked ally also cause their next hit to add 25% Base Damage as Holy.

entries.name: Quarry Continuance
entries.mechanic: Each turn you directly damage the same enemy as the previous turn, advance Continuance through four stages: I: add 20% Base Damage Poison; II: add 20% Cold and -2 Initiative next calculation; III: add 25% Force and -10% Blocked Damage Reduction; IV: add 30% Dark and heal for 20% of that rider’s actual HP damage. Then return to I. Hitting another enemy resets the sequence.

entries.name: Doorborne Reversal
entries.mechanic: Once per combat, when an enemy action leaves you at or below 25% HP but alive, trigger Doorborne Reversal. Gain +2 bonus Energy and a 20% Max HP Shield. Until the end of your next turn, your direct damaging abilities add 25% Base Damage as Holy and 25% as Dark, while direct healing/Shielding effects gain +25% strength. Cannot trigger from self-inflicted damage.

entries.name: Classless
entries.mechanic: Equipping this Impression makes the Vessel CLASSLESS for the next campaign. The character has no normal base class, subclass, class passive, subclass passive, or automatic class-resource package. Instead, the Vessel uses a dedicated Classless Chronicle Rank tree. That tree ultimately provides five Base Ability selections drawn from any unlocked base classes and exactly two Subclass Ability selections drawn from any unlocked subclasses. Selections are configured at the Tavern before a campaign and may be changed there between campaigns. Selected abilities keep their original Energy cost, cooldown, targeting, damage type, weapon requirement, stat-scaling profile, and scaling coefficients. Classless may equip any of the eight weapon types, but an ability-specific weapon requirement must still be satisfied to use that ability. If a selected ability normally requires a class/subclass resource, its Classless Chronicle node imports only the minimum generation/spending rules required for that selected ability to function; it does not grant unrelated class/subclass passives or unselected abilities. The Classless tree cannot import transformation-only boss mechanics, race mechanics, Kept Impression mechanics, equipment-granted abilities, or Tavern Adventurer-exclusive abilities. Classless cannot choose a subclass through the Mantle Room while this Impression is equipped. Because Classless costs 6 Kept Impression slots, a normal 7-slot loadout has only 1 slot remaining for another Impression.

entries.name: Prismwound Ledger
entries.mechanic: The first time each round you deal direct Fire, Cold, Lightning, Poison, Force, Psychic, Holy, or Dark damage, record that type in the Ledger; duplicate types do not add another entry that round. At 3 recorded types, the target of your next direct damaging ability gains Prismwound for 2 turns and the Ledger clears. Prismwound changes based on the three recorded types: Fire adds a 20% Base Damage Burn burst on the target's next turn; Cold gives -2 Initiative on its next calculation; Lightning causes your next hit to restore +1 bonus Energy; Poison applies a 2-turn Poison rider equal to 10% Base Damage per turn; Force gives -15% Blocked Damage Reduction; Psychic gives -8 percentage points Crit Chance; Holy causes 20% of the next direct healing you perform to echo to the lowest-HP real ally; Dark causes your next direct hit to heal you for 15% of actual HP removed. If more than one recorded type would create an effect, all three effects are applied once. Hard control is never created by Prismwound.

entries.name: Cinderwound Pact
entries.mechanic: At the start of combat, choose whether to ignite Cinderwound. While ignited, you are Burning for 3 turns; this self-Burn deals Fire damage equal to 4% Max HP at the end of each of your turns and cannot reduce you below 1 HP. While Cinderwound is Burning, the first direct damaging ability you use each turn adds 25% Base Damage as Fire. If that ability hits an enemy that is also Burning, the rider becomes 35% Base Damage as Fire. Cinderwound counts as a Burn on you for effects that care about being Burning, but it cannot be transferred to another combatant.

entries.name: Rimeglass Heart
entries.mechanic: Direct Cold damage you deal applies 1 Chillglass, maximum 3 per enemy. At 3 Chillglass, consume all stacks and Freeze that enemy for its next action, once per enemy per combat. Frozen is hard control: an ordinary enemy loses its next action, then Frozen ends. Bosses and protected enemies cannot lose their action; instead, 3 Chillglass applies Deep Freeze for 1 turn: -4 Initiative on the next applicable calculation, -20% outgoing damage, and -15 percentage points Dodge Chance. When Freeze or Deep Freeze ends, the target takes 35% Base Damage as Cold.

entries.name: Venomheart Debt
entries.mechanic: At combat start, apply Venom Debt to yourself for 3 turns. At the end of each of your turns it deals Poison damage equal to 3% Max HP and reduces your Incoming Healing by 10% while active. In exchange, the first Poison you apply to an enemy each turn gains one extra turn of duration, maximum +1 from this Impression, and that Poison's first tick deals an additional 20% Base Damage as Poison. Venom Debt cannot be cleansed early by your own effects and cannot reduce you below 1 HP.

entries.name: Cinderburst Fuse
entries.mechanic: Once per enemy per 2 turns, when one of your Burn effects expires naturally or is removed from an enemy, it detonates. The target takes 30% Base Damage as Fire for each turn the Burn still had remaining immediately before it ended, minimum 30% and maximum 90%. Every other enemy takes 40% of the detonation as Fire damage. Cinderburst damage cannot Crit, Lifesteal, or trigger another status explosion.

entries.name: Venomburst Vessel
entries.mechanic: Grants active ability — Venomburst. Cost: 1 Energy. Cooldown: 4 turns. Choose a Poisoned enemy and consume up to 3 remaining Poison turns from one Poison effect you applied. For each turn consumed, deal 35% Base Damage as Poison immediately. Every other enemy receives a new 2-turn Poison dealing 10% Base Damage per turn. Boss/protected Poison duration is never extended by this effect. Venomburst damage cannot recursively trigger itself.

entries.name: Rimeburst Wake
entries.mechanic: When you directly damage a Frozen or Deep-Frozen enemy, you may Rimeburst it, once per enemy per combat. Remove Freeze/Deep Freeze after the triggering hit. The target takes 70% Base Damage as Force plus 40% Base Damage as Cold. Every other enemy takes 35% Base Damage as Cold and gains Shiver for 1 turn: -2 Initiative on its next applicable calculation. Rimeburst Wake cannot itself Freeze.

entries.name: Affliction Cascade
entries.mechanic: Grants active ability — Cascade Detonation. Cost: 3 Energy. Cooldown: 6 turns. Choose an enemy with at least 3 different eligible negative statuses that you applied. Consume 1 remaining turn from up to 4 eligible non-control statuses and create one explosion for each consumed status: Burn = 35% Base Damage Fire; Poison = 35% Poison; Cold/Chill = 30% Cold and -2 Initiative next calculation; defense reduction = 30% Force; mental/Psychic debuff = 30% Psychic; Holy/Dark vulnerability = 30% matching damage type; any other eligible numerical debuff = 25% Psychic. The chosen target takes every explosion. Other enemies take 40% of the total explosion damage. Hard-control duration is never consumed, copied, or extended.

entries.name: Overkill Communion
entries.mechanic: Overkill becomes a healing resource. When your direct damaging ability defeats an enemy, calculate the damage that exceeded the enemy's remaining HP. Heal yourself for 35% of that overkill amount, capped at 10% of your Max HP per defeated enemy. This is explicit Overkill Healing, not Lifesteal, so it is the approved exception to the normal rule that Lifesteal ignores overkill. Summons and damage-over-time effects cannot trigger it.

entries.name: Cinder Siphon
entries.mechanic: Gain 14% Lifesteal from actual HP removed by your Fire damage only. In exchange, your Cold Resistance is reduced by 20 percentage points while this Impression is equipped. Fire Lifesteal follows all normal Lifesteal rules: no healing from overkill, and Incoming Healing modifies the resulting Lifesteal healing.

entries.name: Venom Siphon
entries.mechanic: Gain 18% Lifesteal from actual HP removed by your Poison damage only. In exchange, every Poison applied to you lasts +1 turn when its duration can legally be modified, and your Poison Resistance is reduced by 15 percentage points. Poison Lifesteal cannot heal from overkill.

entries.name: Gloam Siphon
entries.mechanic: Gain 16% Lifesteal from actual HP removed by your Dark damage only. In exchange, direct healing you receive from other characters is 20% weaker. Self-healing and Lifesteal are not reduced by this drawback. Dark Lifesteal cannot heal from overkill.

entries.name: Victory Bloom
entries.mechanic: After every victorious combat, if you are still alive, restore 10% of your Max HP before the mandatory Campsite begins. This cannot revive a defeated character, cannot overheal, and does not create a Shield from excess healing unless another effect explicitly converts overhealing.

entries.name: Tomorrow's Wound
entries.mechanic: Grants active ability — Borrow Tomorrow. Cost: 1 Energy. Cooldown: 5 turns. Until the start of your next turn, after Dodge, Block, resistance, Shield absorption, and all other normal mitigation resolve, defer 40% of the incoming HP damage you would actually take instead of taking it immediately. Store all deferred damage in Tomorrow's Wound. At the start of your next turn, before the natural +1 Energy gain, take the entire stored amount as one damage packet. Deferred damage cannot be Dodged, Blocked, Shielded, redirected, reduced, deferred again, or trigger Borrow Tomorrow a second time. It may reduce you to 0 HP. Self-inflicted damage and already-deferred damage cannot be deferred.

entries.name: Frostburn Paradox
entries.mechanic: While you are Burning, your first direct Cold hit each turn gains +25% Base Damage as Cold and applies Thermal Fracture for 2 turns. Hitting a Thermally Fractured enemy with Fire damage consumes the Fracture, removes 1 turn from one Burn on you, and applies 2 Chillglass to the enemy. If that reaches 3 Chillglass, Rimeglass Heart or another legal Freeze source may Freeze it normally. Frostburn Paradox never creates Freeze by itself.

entries.name: Blightblossom Relay
entries.mechanic: When an enemy dies while carrying a Poison you applied, grow a Blightblossom from the remaining Poison. Every other enemy receives a new Poison for 2 turns whose per-turn damage equals 50% of the defeated enemy's strongest remaining Poison tick, capped at 20% Base Damage per turn. If no other enemy is alive, heal yourself for 5% Max HP instead. A Poison created by Blightblossom Relay cannot create another Blightblossom when it kills an enemy.

entries.name: Affliction Loom
entries.mechanic: The first time each round you personally gain Burn, Poison, Chill/Freeze, or an eligible numerical non-control debuff, weave a Reverse Thread matching it until the end of your next turn. Your next direct damaging ability consumes the Thread: Burn Thread adds 25% Base Damage as Fire; Poison Thread adds 25% Base Damage as Poison; Chill/Freeze Thread adds 20% Base Damage as Cold and -2 Initiative on the target's next applicable calculation; other numerical debuffs add 20% Base Damage as Psychic and copy 25% of the debuff's numerical penalty onto the target for 1 turn when legal. Hard control is never copied.

entries.name: Ruinseed Catalyst
entries.mechanic: Whenever one of your Burn, Poison, or other eligible damaging status effects deals damage, gain 1 Catalyst Seed, maximum 6 and maximum 1 Seed per status effect per turn. At 6 Seeds, your next direct damaging ability plants Ruinseed on the target for 2 turns and consumes all Seeds. While Ruinseed is active, the first Burn tick, first Poison tick, and first direct Cold, Force, Psychic, Holy, or Dark hit the target receives from you each trigger a different rupture, once each: Fire rupture = 20% Base Damage Fire; Poison rupture = 20% Poison; Cold rupture = -2 Initiative next calculation plus 15% Cold; Force rupture = -15% Blocked Damage Reduction for 1 turn plus 15% Force; Psychic rupture = -8 percentage points Crit Chance for 1 turn plus 15% Psychic; Holy rupture = grant the lowest-HP real ally a 4% Max HP Shield plus 15% Holy; Dark rupture = heal you for 15% of the rupture's actual HP damage plus 15% Dark. Ruptures cannot Crit, Lifesteal, recursively trigger, or create additional Catalyst Seeds.

  2) it triggers normally at start of target's next turn
